decisions.why: Lou's rule 25/08/2026: the division's own evidence names products from more than one category, so it goes in all of them rather than picking one — the JADA System, a postpartum haemorrhage device (maternity & obstetrics), sits alongside the LifeBubble umbilical catheter securement system and BoogieBaby aspirators (neonatal equipment)

examples (NXT Family of Urodynamics Systems, Uroflowmeters & Accessories) are urodynamics diagnostic equipment; new type added under endourology 26/08/2026 on Lou's decision, since the existing endourology types (stone/stent/laser/litho) are all kidney-stone focused. The two Optilume BPH products in the same division are catheter/balloon devices for BPH treatment, not urodynamics testing — left out of this mapping, no clear existing type fits them

examples (Spot® Ex, Solar™ Compact System, alpHaONE Wireless pH Capsule Reflux Monitoring System, EverLift® Submucosal Lifting Agent) are GI physiology and motility testing devices — reflux pH monitoring, manometry and endoscopic mucosal resection aids — none of the existing gastro types (haem/snare/stent/energy) fit; new gastro:diag type added under the existing gastro speciality 27/08/2026 on Lou's decision
